page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ine.xlarge is an x86_64 virtual instance from the Enhanced family, operating on the KVM hypervisor. The system is provisioned with 4 dedicated vCPUs backed by an Intel Xeon processor running at a frequency of 2.7 GHz. Total system memory is 8.0 GB, which establishes a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per virtual core.

Hardware accelerators are not present on the ecs.c8ine.xlarge, with the instance configuration reflecting zero GPUs. Persistent local storage is absent, designating the instance as dependent on external storage solutions for persistent data persistence. Network infrastructure specifications indicate a baseline network bandwidth of 7 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned to the system.

The 1:2 compute-to-memory ratio provides cost-efficient core density for operations that prioritize CPU cycles over extensive memory capacity. Tradeoffs include the requirement of remote storage attachment due to the lack of local drives, as well as constrained capacity for memory-heavy databases. The resource balance makes the instance appropriate for compute-oriented workloads, such as build compilation, CI/CD runners, batch processing jobs, and lightweight web serving.
